ASSIGNMENT OF EXCESS DEVELOPMENT RIGHTS (117) Assignment of Excess Development Rights made this 3day of April, 2012, made by Hamilton Lofts LLC ("Assignor"),a New York limited liability company, to Gold 48 LLC (*Assignee"), a New York limited liability company, both having an office of 448 Greenwich Street,#4,NewYork,NY 10013; WHEREAS, Assignor was the Sponsor of a condominium offering plan known as The 117 Edgecombe Avenue Condominium located at 117 Edgecombe Avenue, Borough of Manhattan,NewYork County,City andStateof NewYork,in accordance with the declaration("Declaration") establishing a plan for condominium ownership of said premises under Article 9-B of the Real Property Law of the State of New York, dated March10,2010,and recorded in the NewYork County office of the Register of The City of NewYork on April 15,2010 as CRFN 2010000126242; WHEREAS,in accordancewithArticle30of theDeclaration,Assignorretained the Excess Development Rights (as defined in the Declaration); interest in and to theExcessDevelopmentRights; NOW,THEREFORE,forten dollars andforgood and othervaluable consideration, Assignor assigns of its right,title and interest in and to theExcess Development Rights. .HAMILTONLOFTSLLC By: Hamilton Tofts Managers LLd/Manager By: Name:Romy Goldman Title:Manager
